overview: Typically for office leases, the premises utilities are also paid by the tenant. For Retail leases, most leases relate to common area maintenance. Context: Details to be abstracted from a underwriter perspective and should cover details of utilities to be charged to the tenant part of common area maintenance – including methodology, (will this be invoiced part of common area maintenance or separately charged, if separately charged method (proportionate share). Charges should also include any mark up like an admin fee to be included. For premises utilities will there be a separate meter or sub-metered, extent of responsibility with Landlord or Tenant. Rate structure – typically for HVAC and electricity usage. Utilities covers – water, sewer, electricity, trash and HVAC The clause should include all the points including who is responsible for payment, how is the payment to be calculated based on (metered or sub-metered) or does the Tenant pay directly to the utility service provider. If the utility service is not metered, then ensure the methodology we are using in this instance is provided with clarity. Is there any administrative charge or charge to be paid by the tenant over the utility payment? Are there any charges for after hours utility usage? Under certain circumstances, the lease may state contain language or state that “if landlord does not provide continuous utility to the premises” (that is there is an interruption), then the tenant may have right to be remedied (that is paid back or terminate if there is no quick restoration of services). What is the utility/utilities being considered (note the answer could be multiple eg: Water, Sewer, electricity, however extracting only the relevant is critical to understand the other charges by the underwriter). Who pays for utilities identified about (Landlord or Tenant) How is the tenant charged (if tenant is responsible)  Is if proportionate share or any other calculation How is tenant’s share calculated (is it distributed among the tenants who use the specific service) or is it charged as part of Common Area maintenance. Is there a separate administrative cost What happens if there is an interruption to the service, how does this impact the payment or adjustment.
